import rle.core as rle
import random
import string

# Test examples
assert rle.encode('aaabbc') == 'a3b2c1', f"got {rle.encode('aaabbc')}"
assert rle.encode('a') == 'a1', f"got {rle.encode('a')}"
assert rle.encode('') == '', f"got {rle.encode('')}"
assert rle.encode('abc') == 'a1b1c1', f"got {rle.encode('abc')}"
assert rle.encode('x'*12) == 'x12', f"got {rle.encode('x'*12)}"

# Test TypeError
for bad in [None, 123, [], {}]:
    try:
        rle.encode(bad)
        assert False, f"Expected TypeError for {bad}"
    except TypeError:
        pass

# Round-trip property for random strings
random.seed(42)
for _ in range(1000):
    length = random.randint(0, 20)
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_letters) for __ in range(length))
    encoded = rle.encode(s)
    # ensure encode returns str
    assert isinstance(encoded, str), f"encode returned {type(encoded)}"
    decoded = rle.decode(encoded)
    assert decoded == s, f"Round-trip failed for {s!r}: encode->{encoded!r} decode->{decoded!r}"

print('All tests passed')
